summary: The government has been defunding public education for 40 years, and as a result, low cost or subsidized internet access is the only financially-viable option. Funding for the E-Rate program should be increased, or at the very least, maintained. The very last public spaces that serve everyone (schools and libraries) depend on it. We, the American people, depend on it.
